episodes.synopsis: After the events of the last season, Ye Jiayao finally becomes engaged to Xia Chunyu. Unexpectedly, Chamberlain Ping shows up with an Imperial Edict. What does the Emperor want with Yaoyao?
episodes.title: An Unexpected Turn of Events

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao impresses the Emperor with her cooking at Princess Liuli's birthday banquet. The Emperor sends Chunyu to the Nanyue Kingdom.
episodes.title: His heart!

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao sets off to Nanyue to meet up with Chunyu. On the way, she meets Jing.
episodes.title: Soul-Searching Journey!

episodes.synopsis: Ye Jiayao heads with Jing towards Nanyue to meet Xia Chunyu. Along the way, several refugees from Nanyue begin to appear.
episodes.title: Fated Person

episodes.synopsis: With Ah Ruan as their guide, Yaoyao, Chunyu and Jing set off on their journey to the Nanyue Kingdom.
episodes.title: Don't Worry! There's Food!

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao, Jing and Ah Ruan continue to make their way to the Nanyue Kingdom.
episodes.title: The Trio Who Survive Countless Perils

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao impresses the king of the Nanyue Kingdom with her cooking skills.
episodes.title: Ruan's Home

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao, Jing and Ah Ruan begin their journey back to Jinling.
episodes.title: Wonderful Date

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao impresses the Emperor with her cooking inspired by the journey to Nanyue in preparation for the Banquet of Nations.
episodes.title: The Happy Emperor

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao visits Chunyu's house after finding out that his mother is sick.
episodes.title: Me-Meeting the Parents!

episodes.synopsis: Yaoyao stays up all night preparing for the Banquet of Nations, ensuring that it is a success.
episodes.title: World Banquet!

episodes.synopsis: Finally, it's the day of the wedding!
episodes.title: Cinderella Chef
